patterns.message: Import design-system components from 'index.js', not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().
Font not provided by the design system. Available: Public Sans, Merriweather, Roboto Mono, Source Sans Pro.
<AccordionItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: id, title, content.
<Alert> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: type, heading, slim, noIcon, children.
<Alert> type must be one of 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'success' | 'emergency'.
<Banner> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: tld.
<Crumb> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, href.
<Button> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, size, disabled, icon, iconPosition, children.
<Button> variant must be one of 'default' | 'secondary' | 'base' | 'accent-cool' | 'accent-warm' | 'outline' | 'unstyled'.
<Button> size must be one of 'default' | 'big'.
<Button> iconPosition must be one of 'left' | 'right'.
<Card> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: heading, headingLevel, media, mediaAlt, footer, children.
<Card> headingLevel must be one of 'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4'.
<Checkbox> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, name, disabled.
<Icon> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: name, size, color, title.

<Icon> name must be one of 'close' | 'menu' | 'search' | 'expand_more' | 'expand_less' | 'navigate_next' | 'navigate_before' | 'check' | 'check_circle' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info' | 'arrow_forward' | 'arrow_back' | 'file_download' | 'launch' | 'account_balance' | 'home' | 'attach_money' | 'medical_services' | 'person' | 'lock' | 'mail' | 'public' | 'rss_feed' | 'facebook'.
<Pagination> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: current, total, onChange.
<Radio> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, name, disabled.
<Select> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, id, hint, error, required, width, children.
<Select> width must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'default' | 'lg' | 'full'.
<StepIndicator> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: steps, current, showLabels, counters.
<SummaryBox> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: heading, children.
<Tag> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: color, size, children.
<Tag> color must be one of 'base' | 'primary' | 'primary-dark' | 'secondary' | 'accent-cool' | 'accent-warm' | 'success' | 'light'.
<Tag> size must be one of 'default' | 'big'.
<TextInput> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, id, hint, error, required, type, width.
<TextInput> width must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'default' | 'lg' | 'full'.
